# i18next 25.6.0

This is the official i18next 25.6.0 distribution, vendored because the development environment cannot download npm packages. Only the UMD wrapper has been replaced with an ES module export. The translation engine is unmodified.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/i18next/i18next/v25.6.0/i18next.js

Keep the MIT license alongside the distribution. The adjacent declaration describes only the API used by ADAPT. This can be replaced with the npm i18next package when package downloads are available.
